prompt: In the guide, what's the actual difference between a Display Page Template and a Page Template? We have ~40 HR policy documents and each one needs its own page on the intranet. Which one do I use and what goes wrong if I pick the other?
assertions: Recommends a Display Page Template for the 40 policy pages
States that a Page Template is copied at creation and later edits do not propagate
Mentions a collection (or similar index) for listing the policies
Cites guide locations as page.html#anchor (e.g. templates.html#display)
Labels any claim not from the guide as such (or makes no out-of-guide claims)
Ends by offering to build/demo it in the local Liferay
